mapper.update: MERGE INTO INTERF_OPICS_TGT_SECINFO T USING (SELECT SECID , COUPRATE_8, INTPAYCYCLE, PRODUCT, PRODTYPE, BASIS, INTCALCRULE, INTERESTRATE, ISSDATE, VDATE, MDATE, DENOM, RATECODE, SPREADRATE_8, CCY, DESCR, ISSUEPRICE, INTPAYRULE, SCHECALRULE, FIRSTRATEDAY, WORKDAYRULE, RATEVALUETYPE, RATEVALUEPERIOD, RATEVALUECDTN, RATEVALUEDAYS, ISSUEAMT, SECTYPE, EFFECTFLAG, LSTMNTDATE, SN FROM SDB_V_SECM@OPICS A WHERE A.LSTMNTDATE = #{cDate ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) S ON (TRIM(T.SECID) = 'IB' || TRIM(S.SECID)) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.COUPRATE_8 = S.COUPRATE_8, T.INTPAYCYCLE = S.INTPAYCYCLE, T.PRODUCT = S.PRODUCT, T.PRODTYPE = S.PRODTYPE, T.BASIS = S.BASIS, T.COUPONSPECIES = S.INTCALCRULE, T.INTERESTRATE = S.INTERESTRATE, T.ISSDATE = S.ISSDATE, T.VDATE = S.VDATE, T.MDATE = S.MDATE, T.FACEVALUE = S.DENOM, T.RATECODE = S.RATECODE, T.SPREADRATE_8 = S.SPREADRATE_8, T.CCY = S.CCY, T.DESCR = S.DESCR, T.ISSUEPRICE = S.ISSUEPRICE, T.INTPAYRULE = S.INTPAYRULE, T.SCHECALRULE = S.SCHECALRULE, T.FIRSTRATEDAY = S.FIRSTRATEDAY, T.WORKDAYRULE = S.WORKDAYRULE, T.RATEVALUETYPE = S.RATEVALUETYPE, T.RATEVALUEPERIOD = S.RATEVALUEPERIOD, T.RATEVALUECDTN = S.RATEVALUECDTN, T.RATEVALUEDAYS = S.RATEVALUEDAYS, T.ISSUEAMT = S.ISSUEAMT, T.SECTYPE = S.SECTYPE, T.EFFECTFLAG = #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.LSTMNTDATE = S.LSTMNTDATE, T.SN = S.SN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SECID, COUPRATE_8, INTPAYCYCLE, PRODUCT, PRODTYPE, BASIS, COUPONSPECIES, INTERESTRATE, ISSDATE, VDATE, MDATE, FACEVALUE, RATECODE, SPREADRATE_8, CCY, DESCR, ISSUEPRICE, INTPAYRULE, SCHECALRULE, FIRSTRATEDAY, WORKDAYRULE, RATEVALUETYPE, RATEVALUEPERIOD, RATEVALUECDTN, RATEVALUEDAYS, ISSUEAMT, SECTYPE, EFFECTFLAG, LSTMNTDATE, SN) VALUES ( 'IB' || TRIM(S.SECID), S.COUPRATE_8, S.INTPAYCYCLE, S.PRODUCT, S.PRODTYPE, S.BASIS, S.INTCALCRULE, S.INTERESTRATE, S.ISSDATE, S.VDATE, S.MDATE, S.DENOM, S.RATECODE, S.SPREADRATE_8, S.CCY, S.DESCR, S.ISSUEPRICE, S.INTPAYRULE, S.SCHECALRULE, S.FIRSTRATEDAY, S.WORKDAYRULE, S.RATEVALUETYPE, S.RATEVALUEPERIOD, S.RATEVALUECDTN, S.RATEVALUEDAYS, S.ISSUEAMT, S.SECTYPE, #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.LSTMNTDATE, S.SN)
